verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.sm: Ia outou vivii atu i le ALII. Ou te vivii atu i le ALII ma le loto atoa i le saofaiga a e amiotonu, atoa ma le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.sm: O mea ua faia e le ALII, o mea tetele lava ia, o loo sailia e i latou uma lava o e fiafia i ai.

verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.sm: O mea e viia ma le matagofie o ana galuega ia, e tumau foi lana amiotonu e faavavau.

verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.sm: SALAMO 111,112 Ua fai rna faamanatuga ona vavega; o loo alofa fua mai ma alofa mutimuti vale mai le ALII.

verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.sm: Ua foaiina mai e ia le mea e “ai i e matatau ia te ia; e manatua E ia lana feagaiga e faavavau.

verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.sm: Ua na faaali atu le mana o ana galuega i lona nuu, ina ua avatu ia i latou le tofi o nuu ese.

verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.sm: O galuega a ona aao e moni ia ma le tonu; e faamaoni ana feau uma lava.

verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.sm: E faatumauina ia mea e faavavau faavavau lava; ua faia i le faamaoni ma le tonu.

verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.sm: Na ia avatu le togiola mo lona nuu; na poloai i lana feagaiga 1a faavavau lava ; e paia ma le matautia lona suafa.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.sm: O le mataʻu i le ALIT, o le amataga lea o le poto; ua i ai le mafaufau lelei ia te i latou uma o E fai ia mea; e tumau lona viiga e faavavau lava.
